import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize text label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Parse body_mass_g written as text (e.g. '3,450')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Enforce valid ranges
    df.loc[~df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # sex: keep missing as unknown (do not guess)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('object')
    df.loc[~df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    d = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
